definitions.explanation: Growing rice in paddy fields, from planting to harvest.

examples.japanese: {米作|こめづく}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧な⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧。
examples.english: A region where rice farming thrives.

examples.japanese: ⟦{祖父|そふ}→祖父：01452_sofu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{六十年|ろくじゅうねん}{米作|こめづく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{続|つづ}けて⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: My grandfather has been growing rice for sixty years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{移住|いじゅう}して→移住する：17190_ijuusuru⟧{米作|こめづく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: Recently, some young people move from the city and start growing rice.

notes:
The everyday word; the more formal term is ⟦{稲作|いなさく}→稲作：09494_inasaku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {米作|こめづく}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to grow rice
- {米作|こめづく}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{盛|さか}ん→盛ん：01239_sakan⟧だ: rice farming thrives
- {米作|こめづく}り⟦{体験|たいけん}→体験：11443_taiken⟧: a rice-growing experience (for schoolchildren or visitors)

CULTURAL NOTE:
The rice year runs from ⟦{田植|たう}え→田植え：22734_taue⟧ (planting, around May) to ⟦{稲刈|いねか}り→稲刈り：05933_inekari⟧ (harvest, around September). Many elementary schools let pupils plant and harvest a small paddy.
